sec.title: September 3 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 702)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 3** across lively Chicago sports interviews with legendary Giants manager Leo Durocher, hit parade countdowns for Lucky Strike, full-length theatrical comedy-mysteries, chilling Canadian Okefenokee swamp horror, breaking wire news of the liberation of Lyon, and insightful backstage oral history interviews with Jack Benny, Leo Durocher on *Tom Duggan Sports* (1952), Fredda Gibson on *Your Hit Parade* (1938), Barbara Luddy and Les Tremayne (1940), *Nightfall* (1982), Douglas Edwards on CBS (1944), and Jack Benny with Chuck Schaden (1938–1982):
